data.title: What Strategy (MSTR)'s Pivot From Bitcoin Hoarding to Balance-Sheet Repair Means For Shareholders
data.description: Strategy Inc. recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$122.37 million but a very large net loss of US$8,219.63 million, driven largely by Bitcoin-related unrealized losses, and has begun selling Bitcoin and issuing stock to repurchase preferred shares and build its US dollar reserve. The shift from relentless Bitcoin accumulation to using Bitcoin sales and equity issuance for capital management marks a new phase in Strategy’s attempt to support its preferred...
